scope: Review eight flagged taxonomic/range concepts while native-range sweep remains paused. Resolve only name-rank crosswalk evidence; retain observation identification, ecology, provenance, historical taxon, and county data as untouched.

records.resolution: Do not transfer historical Texas records to revised 2022 taxon concept without specimen re-identification

records.name_crosswalk: Kew accepts Echinocereus enneacanthus var. enneacanthus; ITIS accepts E. enneacanthus subsp. enneacanthus and treats the variety as a synonym
records.resolution: Remove unresolved name-rank flag, preserve the source's unranked spelling as alias; botanical ID and exact original rank remain unverified; never invent a photograph or local occurrence
Modern species concept does not safely resolve broad historical Central Texas records; do not infer county classifications

records.name_crosswalk: ITIS: Philadelphus ernestii accepted, P. texensis synonym; POWO: P. texensis accepted species
records.resolution: Do not pick one taxonomic backbone arbitrarily; retain both searchable labels, need standard selection for project
Keep Texas live-oak evidence distinguishable from Q. fusiformis; skip native-range fast-fill

records.name_crosswalk: Old autonym variety maps to Sagittaria graminea subsp. graminea in ITIS/FNA; Kew's accepted species concept is S. graminea Michx.
records.resolution: Remove missing accepted-name flag; preserve varietal alias, label taxonomic rank differences and leave plant/subspecies determination unverified

records.name_crosswalk: S. drummondii A.Gray ex Hook. & Arn. is linked to S. ghiesbreghtii; later S. drummondii A.Gray ex Torr. is linked to S. texanum
records.resolution: Find original name authority and source before choosing identity; keep two concepts unmerged

records.name_crosswalk: Taraxacum officinale F.H.Wigg. is a synonym of Taraxacum sect. Taraxacum according to Kew
records.resolution: Section rank is not a replacement species identity; no species card duplication or photo assignment
